candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that increases mapSynth_LPBalance by the added LP units.
Replace the incremental update of mapSynth_LPBalance with a direct assignment, losing any prior accumulated balance.
Credit the LP balance to the member key instead of the pool's own key.
Add the minted synth amount instead of the computed LP units to mapSynth_LPBalance.
Invert the onlyPool guard so calls from curated pools revert and non-curated callers pass, changing which keys of mapSynth_LPBalance are updated.
Remove the require check so any caller, including non-curated pools, can mint and update mapSynth_LPBalance.
